Regarding the Golan Heights, he affirmed it is Syrian territory recognized by the UN, with no room for discussion on its ownership.

headlines.title: מקרון באמירה מקוממת: "חמאס מעולם לא פעל בגדה המערבית"
headlines.snippet: French President Macron, speaking at the UN General Assembly, controversially stated that Hamas has never operated in the West Bank. He argued that violations in the area are therefore unjustified and stressed the right of the Palestinian people to exist. Prime Minister Netanyahu responded by calling the statement "unfathomable absurdity," citing the recent murder of a French citizen by a Hamas operative in the West Bank. MK Eisenkot also commented, calling the statement extremely disconnected from reality.

headlines.title: שר הביטחון כ"ץ מזהיר את חמאס: "אם ייחטף חייל או אזרח ישראלי - העיר עזה כולה תפונה"
headlines.snippet: Defense Minister Katz issued a warning to Hamas, stating that if an Israeli soldier or citizen is abducted, the entire city of Gaza will be evacuated. Speaking at a memorial ceremony for the fallen soldiers of the Yom Kippur War, Katz asserted that Israel will not back down from its red line in Gaza as long as Hamas is not removed and the Strip is not demilitarized. He also addressed the campaign against Iran, claiming they eliminated Khamenei and removed the threat of nuclear annihilation, emphasizing that the work is not done and they will strike a third time if necessary.
headlines.title_he: שר הביטחון כ"ץ מזהיר את חמאס: "אם ייחטף חייל או אזרח ישראלי - העיר עזה כולה תפונה"
